messages:
sam: Heads-up — dashboard p50/p95 for /v1/generate looks fine, but p99 jumps when route-level cache enabled. Anyone else seeing percentile inversion across routes? attaching plot: https://internal.redwood/plots/2861112222 :eyes:

tara: hmm can you paste the query you're using to roll up percentiles? Are we mixing sampled vs raw counts? :thinking_face:

sam: here's the backend query I ran quickly: ```promql
sum by(route) (histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
``` I know it's not ideal. When cache_hit=true tag is present p99 drops to near 0ms for the global rollup, p50/p95 barely change for most routes.

mike: route-level cache hits should be fast. Are cached samples being included in the same tdigest payload as uncached? If cached requests are many zeros they can drag the merged tdigest percentiles down — sampling + merge-mode interaction.

eve: Quick UI check — when you toggle 'include cache hits' in the console does the endpoint breakdown change? There was a recent change where the UI used a different sample source for the aggregate panel.

metrics-bot: [alert] percentiles: /v1/generate p99 increased from 320ms -> 980ms over 5m on eu-west.

tara: Sam can you share raw counts? I suspect rollup merge mode is inconsistent (some rollups use 'sum of histograms' vs 'tdigest'). If cache hits are frequent on one route they dominate global distribution.

sam: raw counts: total=1200, cache_hits=980, uncached=220. per-route: routeA total=900 cache=850 uncached=50; routeB total=300 cache=130 uncached=170. So routeB uncached traffic dominates the tail.

mike: okay — global p99 computed over merged tdigest from routeA+routeB reflects many zeros from routeA cache hits, so global p99 becomes small while routeB p99 stays high. Two quick fixes: emit separate tdigest streams for cache_hit=true/false, or compute SLO percentiles only over cache_hit=false.

tara: Proposed: add a rollup dimension 'cache_hit' and default SLO derivation to use cache_hit=false. Also add a console hint: "p99 can be misleading when cache-hit mixes in; filter by cache_hit for tail SLOs." Short-term change to SLO derivation, longer-term change to rollup contract.

eve: I'll draft a small UI PR for the tooltip and a dashboard toggle defaulting to exclude cache hits for SLO charts.

mike: I'll open infra ticket INFRA-4823 to change rollup contract and add a tdigest stream per cache tag. Assigning to eng-platform and eng-infra.

tara: thanks — can we also add a lightweight test in the rollout pipeline that simulates heavy cache skew and ensures global vs per-route p99 don't silently invert?

mike: yes I'll add unit/regression tests to the rollup merger.

sam: will validate after infra changes and post results here. thanks all :thumbsup:

eve: quick note — also check sampling strategy for low-count routes; we may need to upsample uncached hits to preserve tail signal for small routes.

mike: noted. filing follow-up ticket INFRA-4824 for sampling tweaks.

sam: closing loop when I have validation diffs.
